data.standardized_narrative: The balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding of 78.049 million (prior year comparative) for the 2015 year (statement of financial position). The report images supplied do not contain a clear, unambiguous gross figure for the movement in prior years' provisions (gross prior year development) that can be extracted with confidence. Therefore no quantitative prior-year strengthening or release is reported here; narrative and note-level detail needed to compute a gross PYD was not located in the supplied pages.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding located on balance sheet (Statement of financial position) page image (page 22) as 78,049 $000 (used as 78.049 million). Prior-year development (gross movement) could not be unambiguously identified in the supplied images: movement notes and the specific 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column were not clearly visible/extractable. Gross premiums written taken from income statement (185,601 $000) visible on the report (page ~19). The gross premium mix entries and amounts are approximate transcriptions from the segmental/segmental analysis images and are of moderate/low confidence. No claims development triangle was clearly found in the supplied pages. Some tables and notes are partially obscured or rotated making extraction uncertain; figures should be validated against the original PDF.
